rows.sql: SELECT weight FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'dog' AND pet_age IS NOT NULL AND pet_age = (SELECT MIN(pet_age) FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'dog' AND pet_age IS NOT NULL);
SELECT PetType, MAX(weight) AS max_weight FROM Pets WHERE PetType IN ('cat', 'dog') GROUP BY PetType

SELECT s.Fname
FROM Student s
JOIN Has_Pet hp ON hp.StuID = s.StuID
JOIN Pets p ON p.PetID = hp.PetID
WHERE p.PetType IN ('cat', 'dog')
GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Fname
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.PetType) = 2;
SELECT Major, Age FROM Student WHERE StuID NOT IN (SELECT hp.StuID FROM Has_Pet hp JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat')
SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE StuID NOT IN (SELECT hp.StuID FROM Has_Pet hp JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat' AND hp.StuID IS NOT NULL)
SELECT StuID FROM Student WHERE StuID NOT IN (SELECT hp.StuID FROM Has_Pet hp JOIN Pets p ON p.PetID = hp.PetID WHERE p.PetType = 'cat' AND hp.StuID IS NOT NULL)
SELECT PetType, AVG(pet_age) AS average_age, MAX(pet_age) AS maximum_age FROM Pets GROUP BY PetType;
SELECT PetType, AVG(weight) AS average_weight FROM Pets WHERE PetType IN ('cat', 'dog') GROUP BY PetType;
SELECT DISTINCT s.Fname, s.Age FROM Student s INNER JOIN Has_Pet h ON h.StuID = s.StuID
SELECT DISTINCT T1.LName FROM Student AS T1 JOIN Has_Pet AS T2 ON T1.StuID = T2.StuID JOIN Pets AS T3 ON T2.PetID = T3.PetID WHERE T3.PetType = 'cat' AND T3.pet_age = 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_countries FROM countries;
SELECT DISTINCT cn.Model FROM cars_data cd JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId WHERE cd.Weight < (SELECT AVG(Weight) FROM cars_data);
SELECT DISTINCT cm.FullName FROM car_makers cm JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id JOIN car_names cn ON cn.Model = ml.Model JOIN cars_data cd ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId WHERE cd.Year = 1970
SELECT c.Continent, COUNT(cm.Id) AS car_maker_count FROM car_makers cm JOIN countries co ON cm.Country = co.CountryId JOIN continents c ON co.Continent = c.ContId GROUP BY c.Continent;
SELECT AVG(CAST(MPG AS REAL)) AS average_mpg FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 4 AND MPG IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(MPG) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(MPG)) <> 'null';
SELECT MIN(Weight) AS min_weight FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders = 8 AND Year = 1974;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM cars_data WHERE CAST(Horsepower AS INTEGER) > 150
